_comment: Runtime test-case counts, one per server: the number each server's own
test command prints. This is the unit the root README's Quickstart block
claims, and `tools/check-readme.mjs` compares those claims against this
Why a committed file rather than a static count of the source: the README
annotates a *command*, and what a command prints is test CASES. The static
counter in check-readme.mjs counts test FUNCTIONS times a parametrize
factor it can only sometimes resolve, so it is a lower bound — and locking
the README to it froze all five numbers at roughly half the truth.
Freshness is not on the honour system: each server's own CI job asserts,
after running the suite it already runs, that its measured count equals
the entry here. And check-readme.mjs enforces `static <= runtime`, a real
invariant (every `it(` / `def test_` yields at least one case), so a
To update: run the server's test command and copy the number it printed.
